long_biography.plain_text:
Industrialist Carlo De Benedetti helped establish Together to Go, known as TOG, after backing Antonia Madella Noja's proposal for a rehabilitation service for children with complex neurological disabilities. He and his family supported its fundraising, and he made the largest contribution towards constructing its new Milan centre.

Opened in 2023 on the site of disused public showers, the centre gives children individually designed rehabilitation programmes. TOG also developed a digital fabrication laboratory to make assistive tools and later extended its work to young adults through vocational training. De Benedetti became honorary president in 2024, after chairing the foundation through the development of the new premises.
